registered: 2026-10-30, before any image was sent to Jev

design.parcels: 150 images from the parcel-lens version 2 standard test split (75 damaged, 75 clean), random.Random(20261030) sample, never used for tuning; one fixed prompt, no iteration
design.bins: 150 bins from the bin-replenish-lab test split (50 empty, 100 non-empty drawn uniformly from classes low/medium/high), random.Random(20261030); one fixed prompt, no iteration; truth = inventory-record class
design.model: jev-1.14.0 with header TypeSafe-Danger-Zone-Images; at most 5 unscored format-check calls on images outside the samples
design.ci: bootstrap 1000 resamples, seed 7, percentile 95 percent; stratified by label where classes are balanced by design
design.budget: at most 700 HTTP calls in total; abort on 5 consecutive 429s
design.deviation_before_scoring: Native 224x168 parcel PNGs were refused by the API (HTTP 400 'Invalid image dimensions.', 2 unscored calls on train_0000). All parcel images are sent upscaled 2x (448x336 bicubic); the one unscored call at 2x was accepted. Total unscored format-check calls: 3 (limit 5). Bins: one 398x272 photo (id 13582) was refused for dimensions after the first scored call; rule added before any further bin was sent: photos with shorter side <336 px are enlarged to 336 (bicubic). The refused call is kept in calls.jsonl.

claims.text: Presence question (typed yes/no choice, score = P(yes)): AUC >= 0.80 with CI low >= 0.70.
At the model's own answer (yes/no), recall of damaged >= 0.80 and clean false alarms <= 150 per 1,000.
Box on damaged images: median IoU with the generator's damage box >= 0.50.
Box on damaged images: share with IoU >= 0.5 is at least 50 percent.

Presence-first: on clean images the presence step says 'no' (so no false box is raised) at least 80 percent of the time. The box step alone always returns a box (reported as 100 percent of clean images if so).
The local trained model beats Jev zero-shot on AUC on the same 150 images by >= 0.05 (paired CI low > 0).
Four-class accuracy beats the majority-class rate of the sample and macro-F1 >= 0.40.
The local fine-tuned model has higher macro-F1 than Jev on the same bins (paired CI low > 0).
Reliability and speed: >= 98 percent of calls return a valid answer, latency p50 <= 5 s and p95 <= 15 s.
